headline: Energy Tracker, from entry to detail
overview: Rate your energy level 1-5 with date/time and notes. See weekly stats to understand your energy patterns and optimize your day.
targetAudience: Users interested in wellbeing tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Energy Tracker — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the energy rating interface with 1-5 scale, date/time picker, and notes field.
steps.screenshotAlt: Energy Tracker landing page on desktop

keyFeatures: Rate energy levels on a simple 1-5 scale
Log date, time, and notes with each entry
View weekly energy statistics and trends
Identify peak energy times and optimize your schedule
tips: Log your energy level at the same times each day — morning, midday, and evening — for the best patterns.
Note your activities alongside energy ratings to discover what boosts or drains you.
note: Imported from Inner Quest's app-owned walkthrough library. The captures are real product evidence, but their original run manifest and detailed interaction log predate Walkthrough Studio, so freshness is not claimed.
